title: The Shadow That Arrived Before the Balloon
central_conflict: a festival balloon cast a shadow on the field before spectators could see it
decisive_choice: the balloon was concealed behind a hill while the low sun projected its shadow ahead
resolution: moved the viewing point and mapped the balloon's safe approach
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a festival balloon cast a shadow on the field before spectators could see it during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they searched the clouds for a second balloon but found nothing; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the balloon was concealed behind a hill while the low sun projected its shadow ahead; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they moved the viewing point and mapped the balloon's safe approach, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Waterwheel That Skipped Every Seventh Turn

title: The Garden That Flooded Without Rain
central_conflict: a rooftop garden flooded each morning despite clear skies
decisive_choice: condensation from an air-conditioning drain flowed beneath the planting beds
resolution: rerouted the drain and restored the soil's safe moisture level
